title: The owner's rulings of 2026-09-30 on the owner rows are recorded on those rows: two drops, three closes, five parks with a revisit trigger, and OWN-074 kept open against its ruling

source.ref: owner multiple choice 2026-09-30 ~01:35Z (the owner rows), plus the LIVE-659 drop from the ~01:50Z P3 sort

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-30. The owner answered the open owner rows by multiple choice at ~01:35Z. This row records each answer on its row as a fragment (ADR-1635), with the consequence in ADR-1672. No code changes; the only prose outside the ledger is the token expiry in docs/RUNBOOKS.md and .github/workflows/maintenance.yml, and a ruling note under Phase 11 in docs/CORE-MODEL.md. The same day's other two rounds, "Park with the native app" for the ten iOS readiness rows (~01:45Z) and the parks of the P3 sort (~01:50Z), are recorded by HYG-157 in a companion PR, split off to keep each PR under the size gate.

THE RULINGS, quoted.
1. LIVE-455 (the Phase 11 six-week field test): "Remove this field test". Closed as dropped; the start reading stays in its detail; the PROG-R11 instrument and the weekly sweep reading stay.
2. OWN-011 (Google OAuth verification for contact import): "Park until 75 users". Parked; reopen when Google identities in auth.identities reach 75 (cap 100; about 32 on 2026-08-19).
3. DEF-A2P (A2P 10DLC SMS registration): "Park until SMS is scheduled". Parked; file at least 3 weeks before any SMS feature ships (carrier review 10 to 15 days).
4. OWN-062 (cost baseline and unit economics figures): "Park until revenue". Parked until the first paid production order. Flagged on the row: one event_tickets row was already settled on 2026-09-21, so the ledger reads the trigger as the first paid order after 2026-09-30 until the owner says otherwise.
5. LIVE-060 (the quarterly moderated research round): "Park until launch". Parked to 2026-12-21.
6. LIVE-234 (prove each money loop once in production): "Wait for real customers". Parked to the first real sales (Returning Home, 2026-10-23), still P0, probe unchanged.
7. OWN-074 (Temple of Aset has no Stripe Connect account): "Already handled". NOT closed: production at 01:37Z shows the Returning Home host with stripe_account_id null and charges and payouts disabled. Ruling and reading are both on the row; it stays open.
8. LIVE-273 (SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN expiry): done. Rotated 2026-09-30 to github-actions-frequency-web-2 (project-scoped, read-only, expires 2027-09-28), old tokens deleted, proven by check:migrations on #3089 at 01:28Z (749 ⇄ 749).
9. OWN-085 (the Space email AUP needs counsel): "Ship without counsel review". Closed; the build is LIVE-729, its own PR.
10. OWN-084 / OWN-088 (file backup): the provider is "Cloudflare R2", with env vars R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and R2_BACKUP_BUCKET (bucket frequency-storage-backup) on Vercel Production, the names the HYG-144 build branch already reads. Recorded on OWN-088 (open until they are set), HYG-144 and OWN-084.
11. OWN-083 (Sentry DSN): "Set it up now". Closed: it was already set up on 2026-09-29 18:56Z through the Sentry Vercel integration, and production /api/status reads monitoring.sentry true at 2026-09-30T01:35Z on f7f7d30.
12. OWN-077 and OWN-087 (seed a Journey cohort run; verify a business or practitioner persona): "I'll do both with my Space". Recorded; both stay open.
13. LIVE-659, from the ~01:50Z P3 sort: dropped ("owner ruled drop 2026-09-30: internal nicety, no user").

HOW. check:backlog has four statuses (open, done, parked, blocked), so a dropped row closes as done with DROPPED in its detail and a manual probe saying nothing was proven. Each parked row carries parkedUntil and its trigger in notes, keeps its probe, and leaves its wave by itself (ADR-1635). HYG-138's done probe held LIVE-234, DEF-A2P, PROG-GD6 and LIVE-455 unparked and read the base file; it now accepts a row whose notes (or a closed row's detail) name an owner ruling or sort dated 2026-09-30, and reads the merged view. OWN-084's ownerAction moves from ruling to waiting, since no ruling is left there.

CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1672). The probe reads the merged view and fails on main (30975a1b0), where LIVE-455 is open.

verify.cmd: node -e 'let d;try{d=require("./scripts/lib/ledger.mjs").loadBacklog(".")}catch(e){console.error(String(e));process.exit(79)}const fs=require("fs");const by=new Map(d.entries.map((e)=>[e.id,e]));const bad=[];const ruled=(e)=>/ADR-1672/.test((e.detail||"")+" "+(e.notes||""));const closed=(e)=>e.status==="done"&&e.closed==="2026-09-30"&&ruled(e);const dropped=(e)=>closed(e)&&/DROPPED/.test(e.detail||"");const parked=(e)=>e.status==="parked"&&/parkedUntil/.test(e.notes||"")&&ruled(e);const open=(e)=>(e.status==="open"||e.status==="blocked")&&ruled(e);const want=(what,ok,ids)=>{for(const id of ids){const e=by.get(id);if(!e)bad.push(id+" is gone");else if(!ok(e))bad.push(id+" is "+e.status+", the 2026-09-30 ruling says "+what)}};want("dropped",dropped,["LIVE-455","LIVE-659"]);want("done",closed,["LIVE-273","OWN-085","OWN-083"]);want("parked with a revisit trigger",parked,["OWN-011","DEF-A2P","OWN-062","LIVE-060","LIVE-234"]);want("open, with the ruling recorded",open,["OWN-074","OWN-088","OWN-077","OWN-087","HYG-144"]);const l=by.get("LIVE-455");if(l&&!/THE START READING/.test(l.detail||""))bad.push("LIVE-455 lost its start reading");const env=["R2_ACCOUNT_ID","R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID","R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY","R2_BACKUP_BUCKET"];for(const id of ["OWN-088","HYG-144"]){const e=by.get(id);if(!e)continue;if(!/Cloudflare R2/.test(e.detail||""))bad.push(id+" does not name Cloudflare R2");for(const v of env)if(!(e.detail||"").includes(v))bad.push(id+" does not name "+v);if(/BACKUP_S3_/.test(e.detail||""))bad.push(id+" names BACKUP_S3_ variables, which nothing reads")}if(!fs.existsSync("docs/ledger/adr/ADR-1672.md")&&!fs.readFileSync("docs/DECISIONS.md","utf8").includes("## ADR-1672:"))bad.push("ADR-1672 is not recorded");if(bad.length){console.error("HYG-156: "+bad.join("; "));process.exit(1)}console.log("ok: 2 dropped, 3 closed, 5 parked with a trigger, 5 open with the ruling, the four R2 env names on OWN-088 and HYG-144")'
verify.note: Reads the merged ledger view (ADR-1635) in-process: LIVE-455 and LIVE-659 closed 2026-09-30 as DROPPED; LIVE-273, OWN-085 and OWN-083 closed 2026-09-30; OWN-011, DEF-A2P, OWN-062, LIVE-060 and LIVE-234 parked with a parkedUntil note; OWN-074, OWN-088, OWN-077, OWN-087 and HYG-144 still open; every one of them citing ADR-1672; LIVE-455 keeps its start reading; OWN-088 and HYG-144 name Cloudflare R2 and all four R2_* variables (R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, R2_BACKUP_BUCKET) and no BACKUP_S3_* name; ADR-1672 exists (as a fragment, or in DECISIONS.md after compaction, which is read only then). The iOS and P3 parks are HYG-157's probe. Fails on main at 30975a1b0, where LIVE-455 is open. About 165 ms CPU.
